stemMarkdown: A rectangular garden 45 m by 18 m is surrounded by a path 4 m wide running all around it on the outside. Find the area (in square m) of the path.
solutionMarkdown: The outer rectangle measures $53$ m by $26$ m, an area of $1378$ square m. Subtracting the garden's $810$ square m leaves $568$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The path widens the plot on both sides, so each dimension grows by twice the width.
